tool.name: Llama 3.2 Vision (11B)
tool.summary: Open-weights multimodal vision-language model capable of image understanding, visual reasoning, chart analysis, and document parsing.
tool.architecture: Vision encoder adapter integrated into Llama 3.2 text decoder.
tool.usage:
from transformers import MllamaForConditionalGeneration, AutoProcessor
model = MllamaForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained("meta-llama/Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct", device_map="auto")
tool.limitations: Vision encoder increases VRAM requirements during high-resolution multi-image processing.
